$comment: Generated by scripts/generate-design-manifest.mjs from kernel sources and pack catalogs — do not edit by hand. Regenerate with: npm run codegen:design-manifest. Vocabulary values are the append-only public contract (docs/landing-kernel-spec.md §8).

stylePresetDescriptions.dark-dev: Developer launch page: near-black ground, one saturated accent, a three-bloom aurora under film grain.
stylePresetDescriptions.soft-saas: Friendly light SaaS: white ground with an iridescent accent, cyan and pink aurora wash.
stylePresetDescriptions.editorial: Folio paper-and-ink: serif display, rules instead of cards.
stylePresetDescriptions.brutalist: The anti-median page: zero radius, hard ink borders, no shadows, uppercase display on stark paper.
stylePresetDescriptions.warm-boutique: Menu and salon warmth: cream and terracotta, serif display, pill controls, soft big radius.
stylePresetDescriptions.mono-utility: Spec-sheet minimalism: mono display, thin rules, the accent only on links, CTAs and numbers.
stylePresetDescriptions.aurora-dark: Molten flagship: true-black ground, one violet-cyan-pink ribbon sweeping the hero, glass cards.
stylePresetDescriptions.luxe-light: Polished fintech: near-white ground, tight deep ink, hairlines, crisp two-layer elevation.
stylePresetDescriptions.atelier: Gallery-quiet portfolio: near-white walls, light tracked small caps, hairlines, no wash; photographs carry the color.
stylePresetDescriptions.heirloom: Romantic wedding stationery: Fraunces with an italic accent word, ivory ground, champagne hairlines, botanical green.
stylePresetDescriptions.tourbook: Expedition field journal: black and white under grain, condensed uppercase masthead, kinetic photo strips.
stylePresetDescriptions.monolith: Severe monochrome: monumental type past the scale ceiling, stroke-only accent word, razor hairlines.
stylePresetDescriptions.lanternlight: Night celebration: true-black ground, white ink, Fraunces with an italic accent; photographs carry the color.
stylePresetDescriptions.sitework: Trades plan table: work paper ruled in a site grid, stenciled uppercase signage, one safety-orange accent.
stylePresetDescriptions.brownstone: Residential listing sheet: limestone paper, navy serif, one brick accent, mounted-photo cards.
stylePresetDescriptions.marquee: Stage night: true-black ground, white Fraunces caps set like a playbill, strictly monochrome.
stylePresetDescriptions.ballroom: Black tie: warm candlelit near-black, gold-foil accent, Fraunces past the scale ceiling, one slow spotlight.
stylePresetDescriptions.picnic: Backyard party: sunny cream paper, tomato-red accent, marigold and sky washes, name-tag pills.
stylePresetDescriptions.chalk: Training floor: black rubber and gym chalk, stenciled uppercase signage, strictly monochrome.
stylePresetDescriptions.hymnal: Midnight service: warm near-black under grain, monumental bone signage, hairlines, one candle-lit accent.
stylePresetDescriptions.broadside: Gig poster on the venue door: aged paper under a halftone screen, display caps past the ceiling.
stylePresetDescriptions.crt: Phosphor terminal: pure black, mono type, scanline raster under an accent glow the brand colors.
stylePresetDescriptions.handheld: Handheld LCD: light pea-green glass, olive ink, chunky mono caps, dithered pixel wash.
stylePresetDescriptions.lounge: Night lounge: neutral near-black, flat charcoal panels, pill shapes, one blooming accent.
stylePresetDescriptions.retroware: Bevel-chrome desktop: silver window chrome, zero radius, inset bevels instead of elevation.
stylePresetDescriptions.tideline: Coastal timber house: fog-slate ground, bone ink, thin monumental Fraunces over photographs that dissolve into mist.
stylePresetDescriptions.memphis: 90s Miami pop: white ground, black ink, hot pink with aqua and lemon, italic Rubik Black, hard offset shadows, confetti gutters.
stylePresetDescriptions.jacaranda: LA sign-painter: cream board, jacaranda-purple ink, sign-red asks, painted letters with a sunset drop shade and a brush script.
stylePresetDescriptions.tabloid: City tabloid front page: newsprint, heavy condensed Anton caps, serif column type, black rules, one fire-engine red.
stylePresetDescriptions.gameday: Sportswear campaign on the outfield: striped turf ground, white condensed block caps leaning italic, slanted plate CTAs.
stylePresetDescriptions.creature: 1950s drive-in one-sheet: midnight blue under grain, cream poster caps with a blood-orange extruded drop, acid-green spot.
stylePresetDescriptions.riso: Two-drum risograph botanical print: warm uncoated paper, sage ink, fluorescent orange, photographs re-separated into two inks.
stylePresetDescriptions.paintchip: Paint-chip deck: Swiss color-blocking, flat fields edge to edge, huge tight grotesk caps, coral accent.
stylePresetDescriptions.schematic: Techno flyer meets wiring diagram: near-black, electric cyan, sodium-orange spark, thin white circuit line art.
stylePresetDescriptions.sunbelt: Desert modernism: sand ground, burnt umber, hot orange and sun yellow, fat rounded 70s display, sunburst ornament.
stylePresetDescriptions.crown: Late-90s glossy cover: deep plum night, chrome display caps with a gold accent word, stacked cover lines.
stylePresetDescriptions.vanity: Beauty counter after hours: black lacquer, Bodoni Moda display, blush and cherry, tiny wide-tracked caps.
stylePresetDescriptions.midcentury: 1950s furniture catalog: warm stock, walnut ink, mustard, burnt orange and olive, condensed caps, atomic starbursts.
stylePresetDescriptions.photobooth: Photo-booth zine: booth strips and flash snapshots taped to newsprint, felt-tip marker, typewriter details, hot pink and cobalt.
stylePresetDescriptions.disco: 1970s disco supper club: black lacquer, red, hot pink and gold foil, Bodoni caps, a swash script, a mirror ball.
stylePresetDescriptions.wayfinding: 1970s transit signage: forest-green sign panels, white ground, signal yellow, heavy grotesk caps, circular pictograms.
stylePresetDescriptions.groove: 1970s soul LP sleeve: amber into burnt orange and cocoa, cream Cooper-style caps, a record-cover hero and tracklists.
stylePresetDescriptions.inkblot: Gallery poster: off-white museum wall, ultramarine ink, a huge centered high-contrast serif, wall-label cards.
stylePresetDescriptions.bubblegum: Y2K candy pop: bubblegum pink, mint and cherry, inflated glossy balloon caps, die-cut stickers, jelly buttons.
stylePresetDescriptions.snapshot: The fridge door: family prints taped up at a lean, felt-tip captions, condensed near-black caps with a tomato-red line.
stylePresetDescriptions.rodeo: Rodeo poster and ranch brand: wood-type Western caps, parchment, sunset orange, turquoise and sage, a rope frame.
stylePresetDescriptions.vitrine: Portrait sitter's wall: flat window-light stone, a small refined Garamond, museum-label caption bands under every frame.
stylePresetDescriptions.seamless: Headshot studio: white walls, a small clean grotesque, the only color the seamless paper behind each face.
stylePresetDescriptions.liner: Liner notes: a near-black sleeve (warm-white in light), a plain grotesque set small, a wall of square record covers.
stylePresetDescriptions.seafog: Sea fog: a grey-blue coastal morning, a light Cormorant with a small Jost, hairlines, the photographs carrying the coast.
stylePresetDescriptions.harvest: Orchard harvest: forest-green stock and ivory ink (ivory in light), a light Newsreader, green caption bands between the frames.
stylePresetDescriptions.carton: Faire-part: cornflower ink on warm paper, an enormous hairline Bodoni, a ruled column, no photograph needed.
stylePresetDescriptions.daybook: The wedding morning, documented: white stock, a light grotesk, script captions, dusty rose and sage, an hour-by-hour album.
stylePresetDescriptions.jharokha: The jewel box: emerald velvet, ivory-gold ink, a heavy Devanagari-born serif, arched event windows, gold filigree rules.
stylePresetDescriptions.horizon: The coastal masthead: white stock, graphite ink, a wide light Lexend in tracked caps, the photograph as a panorama.
stylePresetDescriptions.shingle: The engraved quarterly: ivory laid stock, navy ink, Caslon at display size over its text cut, a crowned crest and fleurons.
stylePresetDescriptions.limestone: The private atelier: warm limestone stock, umber ink, a taupe ask, a Didone over an old-style book face, arched portraits.
stylePresetDescriptions.cognac: The ritual room: espresso ground, cream ink, a cognac ask, walnut rules, a sharp display serif over a text serif with a true italic.
stylePresetDescriptions.plantroom: Estate plant room: graphite and copper, a condensed engineering sans with a monospace spec voice, tagged equipment cards.
stylePresetDescriptions.stormline: Storm dispatch desk: harbor navy and signal amber on white, a heavy grotesque, a live dispatch board and a frosted intake card.
stylePresetDescriptions.plaster: Garden journal: warm lime plaster, an old-style italic serif, olive green and lavender, ruled story cards and an engraved sprig.
stylePresetDescriptions.basalt: Moss garden in fog: basalt-dark ground, a light wide-spaced sans, one maple red, frames stepped like stones on a path.
stylePresetDescriptions.whiteglove: White-glove household: pure white, black geometric type, a sage kicker, hairline cards and square ink buttons.
stylePresetDescriptions.palmbeach: Palm Beach club: flamingo blush and palm green, spaced Caslon caps with an italic hero, gold rules, a bamboo frame.
stylePresetDescriptions.parlor: Southern parlor in daylight: magnolia blush and walnut, a Baskerville with an italic last line, gilt rules, arched portraits.
stylePresetDescriptions.trailhead: Front Range field journal: oat paper, pine ink, a rounded book serif, pencil trail maps, aspen gold used small.
stylePresetDescriptions.hearth: A lounge in the West End: warm cream, plum, sienna and ochre, a bold display serif, a woven textile edge.
stylePresetDescriptions.colophon: A university press: cream paper, oxblood ink, one book serif with its drawn small capitals, a printer's star.
stylePresetDescriptions.boreal: A Minnesota winter indoors: winter white and slate, a light humanist sans, one peach accent.
stylePresetDescriptions.terrazzo: Lakeside studio: white terrazzo flecked terracotta and lake blue, a quiet geometric sans, soft stone corners.
stylePresetDescriptions.picturebook: Storybook first visit: paper white, leaf green and marigold, a soft rounded serif, gouache pages, leaf-green pills.
stylePresetDescriptions.seaglass: Ocean-view practice: sea glass and sand, a narrow modern serif with a true italic, terracotta pills, arched photographs.
stylePresetDescriptions.limone: The Italian coast on film: chalk white and lemon, a hairline display face over a small-cap sans, square corners.
stylePresetDescriptions.alpine: The expedition field sheet: glacier white and granite, a wide heavy grotesque, mono legends, one magenta accent.
stylePresetDescriptions.milkglass: The daylight newborn studio: milk white and sage, a thin book serif over a light grotesque, soft photograph tiles.
stylePresetDescriptions.darkroom: The portrait studio after dark: charcoal and silver, a book serif with engraved capitals, matted museum prints.
stylePresetDescriptions.buttercream: Picnic blanket: buttercream ground, cocoa ink, a soft rounded Fraunces over Figtree, square frames, no shadow.
stylePresetDescriptions.vineyard: Harbor at dusk: deep navy ground, warm-white ink, Baskervville over Caslon's text cut, hairline rules, no shadow.
stylePresetDescriptions.adobe: Birth house in the valley: adobe plaster ground, clay ink, olive and fired-clay bands, Alegreya over Alegreya Sans, soft corners.
stylePresetDescriptions.fogline: Morning fog: white ground, plum ink, dusty rose accent, Instrument Serif over Instrument Sans, hairline rules, no shadow.
stylePresetDescriptions.limewash: Lime plaster in daylight: bone ground, umber ink, burnt-clay accent, Castoro over Spectral, square corners, no shadow.
stylePresetDescriptions.miradouro: Lisbon at the last light: limestone ivory, espresso ink, bordeaux accent, Noto Serif Display light and italic over Manrope.
stylePresetDescriptions.sprocket: South London on film: concrete off-white, near-black ink, Klein blue, Bricolage Grotesque condensed over Geist and Geist Mono.
stylePresetDescriptions.galley: A ship's galley in print: oyster white, cast-iron ink, kelp green, Besley's Clarendon over IBM Plex Sans and Plex Mono.
stylePresetDescriptions.baylight: Marine light: fog-pale ground, spruce ink, sound-green accent, Noto Serif Display Light over Be Vietnam Pro, square corners.
stylePresetDescriptions.schist: Drafting-room white: near-black ink as the accent, one vermilion for numerals, Geist Light over Geist with Geist Mono labels, square corners.
stylePresetDescriptions.galleyproof: The galley proof: bone paper, carbon ink, one proof-red mark, Redaction 35 over Martian Mono, square corners, no motion.

treatments.grain: Film grain as identity, not just banding control.
treatments.glow: Accent light blooms behind CTAs and display moments.
treatments.outline: Stroke-only display letterforms on the accent word.
treatments.hairline: Razor-thin frames instead of shadow elevation.
treatments.scanline: The CRT raster as a fixed overlay of 1px rows in the register's ink.
treatments.pixel: A dithered checker wash, the shading a four-shade LCD could do.
treatments.mist: Full-bleed photographs dissolve into the page ground at their edges.
treatments.pop: 90s pop print: type and cards cut in ink with hard offset shadows, ink-tape kickers, a starburst badge.
treatments.confetti: The register's sparse ornament tile drawn in the page gutters, never behind copy.
treatments.halftone: Photographs print through a fine dot screen with the contrast pressed up.
treatments.sport: Sportswear campaign: condensed caps leaning italic, accent-tape kickers, slanted CTA plates, a short hero.
treatments.pulp: Creature-feature poster: extruded hand-lettered caps, billing tabs, a starburst badge, lobby-card media.
treatments.two-ink: Risograph: photographs re-separated into two spot inks off-register on spot-2 paper, a rubber-stamp caption.
treatments.colorblock: Swiss color-blocking: flat fields edge to edge, flat chips with a hard ink offset, nothing rounded.
treatments.signpaint: Sign-writer's hand: outlined painted letters with a spot-1 drop shade, brush-script accents, board CTAs.
treatments.linework: The ornament as thin schematic line art over the photo hero; readouts as instrument strips.
treatments.sunburst: A rising half-sun of rays behind a stacked-shadow readout, arched hero windows, hung price tags.
treatments.metallic: Glossy 90s cover: chrome display with a gold accent word, masthead over cover lines, gold hairlines.
treatments.lacquer: Beauty counter: high-contrast fashion serif, blush first line, lipstick accent word, framed shade cards.
treatments.atomic: 1950s catalog: off-page split photo beside a ruled copy panel, atomic ornament, numbered catalog strips.
treatments.zine: Friendship zine: taped kicker labels, marker display with an accent swoosh, tilted white-bordered snapshots.
treatments.mirrorball: Disco supper club: sparkle-star kickers, foil rules, script accent phrase, foil pills, a mirror-ball seal.
treatments.transit: Transit wayfinding: the hero as an accent sign panel with a signal rule, route-bar kickers, pictogram icons.
treatments.sleeve: Soul LP sleeve: square record-cover hero photo, a record-label seal, Side A / Side B tracklists.
treatments.wall-label: Gallery poster: unframed artworks multiplied into the wall, a centered museum title, wall-label cards.
treatments.candy: Y2K candy: inflated glossy display with a candy drop, die-cut sticker asides, glossy pill cards, jelly CTAs.
treatments.taped: Fridge door: taped white-bordered prints at a lean, felt-tip captions, a sticky-note seal, marker-red CTAs.
treatments.lariat: Rodeo poster: a rope frame around the hero photo and banner, star-flanked kickers, a ribbon credit, ticket cards.
treatments.ruled: Faire-part: enormous statement names, a tracked-caps line under them, the prose one flush column between ink hairlines.
treatments.keepsake: Wedding album: a photographic timeline with large light times and script captions, a one-line rate, a heart rule, a pill ask.
treatments.filigree: Jewel box: arched event panels over gold name plates, double gold frames on the package board and the ask, a lotus rule.
treatments.panorama: Coastal masthead: the name set wide above a ruled line of places and a panorama, ruled kickers, a quiet ruled ask.
treatments.engraved: Country-house quarterly: the crest over the hero's line, a centered engraved title, fleuron rules, small-caps figures, an outlined ask.
treatments.alcove: Private atelier: arched portraits in a stone border, ranks ruled apart, a dotted line of filter words, a quiet centered ask.
treatments.ritual: Ritual room: the steps as a numbered strip with their minutes, kickers between long rules, an italic testimonial, a still rates line.
treatments.gauge: Plant-room spec sheet: monospace kickers between accent rules, specimens as tagged equipment cards with a service interval.
treatments.dispatch: Dispatch board: day rows as a dark board of live rows with status dots, the form-first capture as a frosted intake card.
treatments.journal: Garden journal: stories as ruled cards with the photo beside the text, italic datelines, an engraved sprig in the margin.
treatments.stillness: Garden walk: sequence frames as wide strips stepped left and right, numbered in light caps, a small stamped seal.
treatments.concierge: House manager's note: spot-1 tracked-caps kickers, the message thread on a quiet white card, square ink CTAs.
treatments.cabana: Club calendar: a bamboo frame around the page, kickers between gold rules, spaced caps, month panels, notice cards.
treatments.gilt: Southern parlor: kickers between gilt rules, a warm-graded photo hero, a framed-photo timeline, arched portraits.
treatments.fieldbook: Trail journal: left-set pages, pencil-trail kickers, a pine-graded photo hero, field notes with a pencil map each.
treatments.weave: Collective lounge: a woven textile edge, diamond kickers, a portrait roster with pill filters, forest and sienna bands.
treatments.marginalia: Annotated edition: small-caps kickers under a printer's star, a sample report on paper with numbered margin notes, ruled columns.
treatments.frost: Winter indoors: slate copy over a frost-washed photo hero, a quiet first-90-days track ending in peach, white cards.
treatments.terrazzo: Lakeside studio: ruled second-ink kickers, soft-cornered before/after plates, a pictogram rail in one white panel.
treatments.picturebook: Storybook: illustrated steps as numbered book pages under a leaf-sprig heading, a ruled fact strip, soft pills.
treatments.seaglass: Ocean view: rule-flanked terracotta kickers, stage cards under arched photographs, round portrait medallions.
treatments.limone: Italian coast: a wide-capital wordmark masthead, captioned full-bleed stacks, contact sheets on a chalk mat.
treatments.alpine: Field sheet: a wide heavy wordmark, survey-slate stacks in mono, places as ruled spec cards, a magenta ask.
treatments.milkglass: Daylight studio: thin spaced-capital name, a light serif, a session builder of photograph tiles and a serif total.
treatments.darkroom: Print room: an engraved-capital name, prints matted on the charcoal wall with engraved plaques, a hairline ask.
treatments.framestack: Full-bleed stack: hero and frames at one size, the nav floating over the photo, quiet hero copy, prose as short bands.
treatments.tintbands: With framestack: the bands between the photos as painted plates — prose band and colophon in the accent, caption bands in spot 1.
treatments.inkover: Full-bleed hero over a pale photo: copy (and a floating nav) in the page ink over a wash of the page ground, not white on a scrim.
treatments.roomline: With framestack: captions inside the photos — the hero line and each overlay caption as one quiet serif line, the wordmark in caps.
treatments.miradouro: With framestack: the creator's diary — italic serif captions and accent, text-link asks, uncarded plates, italic numerals and quote.
treatments.sprocket: The film creator's page: a one-line condensed masthead name, mono labels, amber grease pencil, numbered plates, a solid blue band.
treatments.galley: The chef's photographic résumé: ticket-mono kickers and years, a hairline timeline, press-clipping stories, a ruled four-up.
treatments.soundings: With framestack: waterfront plates — an address and its particulars in each photo's foot, metrics as chart soundings.
treatments.monograph: With framestack: the architect's monograph — hero copy on the paper under the plate, numbered plate labels, a ruled index of works.
treatments.proofmark: The one-line page: a badged statement hero fills the first screen at poster scale, names as a comma-run, one closing line with an arrow.
